run_install_test_case: run the CTestCase on_run_case to test WASM app install, query, and uninstall lifecycle
install_app: install a WASM app by name and .wasm file path using install_app
uninstall_app: uninstall a previously installed WASM app by name using uninstall_app
query_and_check_apps: query installed apps with query_app and verify with check_query_apps
setup_and_cleanup_test_env: start the test environment with start_env and stop it with stop_env
